answer: Work history is time-locked: a receipt is only creditable after 72 hours, and any failed audit publishes the whole chain, including the identity that signed it. A quorum drawn from three unrelated subnetworks re-verifies, and disagreement leaves a violet mark on the record that never clears. The effect is a ripple outward from each fraud: one bad receipt contaminates the history that funded it. Old relic accounts cannot be sold clean, because buyers read the failures.
